description:

description:

Identical twins Amanda and Emily Gale brave storms and struggle as they catch giant redfish and try their hand at dove hunting the farm fields of North Carolina.

title: Uncharted Waters With Peter Miller
description:
S04 E01 — Wahoo and Swordfish in Florida Part 1
Peter is joined by his son Niles and Captains Brandon Mullar and Garret Wade in the Florida Keys in search of wahoo, swordfish and more; they head down to Hawks Cay and then onto Key West for a lesson in the art of cigar rolling at Rodrigues Cigars.

title: Livin' the Dream With Captain Jimmy Nelson
description:
S09 E03 — Inshore Offshore Fishing in Costa Rica Pt1
Livin' the Dream follows Captain Jimmy Nelson and his wife Luiza as they travel and fish in exotic locales.

description:

description:

Striper surf fishing is full-on in New Jersey; Rockstar Dean Ween and "Man vs. Food" host Casey Webb join Nick's local crew for mind-blowing, hardcore surf action from the sands.
